inherited_trial17.limitation: Older whole-allocation holds inherited unchanged, not recomputed or released from potentially incomplete per-call exports.

limitations: Captured model-call exports only; not the supplier account ledger or a proof of total historical spend.
Calls without manifests, direct calls, other directories, other ledgers and missing exports may be absent.
World model-result audit completeness and capture-to-reservation foreign-key linkage are not certified by this inventory.
Unknown reservations are conservative recorded occupancy, not actual payment and not guaranteed final maximum if the provider estimate was low.
No new paid trial is authorized by this artifact; no monthly CNY100 qualification follows from it.
Trial18 has preparation files only; it is not counted as a paid run.

method.access: Only existing JSON/JSONL/Python evidence bytes read. No SQLite, .env, provider clients, production ledger or old runner imported/executed.
method.deduplication: Reservation ID is cross-run identity; identical duplicate export rows would count once; conflicting receipts require explicit review and cannot settle earlier unknowns automatically.
method.legacy_policy: Budget-denied zero-token/zero-cost rows are audit events, not paid provider calls or new holds. Non-denial legacy billing would remain separately unqualified.
method.numeric_method: Decimal(str(price_usage_row(row).cny)); sum without row rounding; display at 7 decimals
method.unknown_policy: Retain max(recorded reservation, recorded usage estimate, repriced partial-usage lower bound). These exports have zero-token unknown rows. Never release by age or treat holds as paid spend.

scope: top-level /tmp/*/manifest.json contract longitudinal-journey.1 synthetic=false plus inherited immutable Trial17 baseline
